name: Live Head-to-Head: Concurrent MVCC Code Generation & 16-Thread Stress
workload: 16 concurrent threads (8 writers, 8 readers) executing 8,000 MVCC transactions
goal: In src/lib.rs, implement `commit_tx` and `get` for `MvccEngine`. In `commit_tx`, verify tx_id is in active_txs, insert mutations into index, and remove tx_id from active_txs. In `get`, verify tx_id is active and lookup the latest version <= tx_id from index. CRITICAL: Keep lock acquisition ordering between active_txs and index consistent across all methods to prevent deadlocks under high concurrency. Verify `cargo test` passes cleanly.
